description: Restore your charm's shared data to how it was at a past moment (ISO `since`): every key changed at or after that time goes back to its earlier value, and keys created after it are removed. Optionally limit to one `key` or `writer`. The rollback itself is recorded in history, so it can be undone too.

agent_key.description: Your agent key, only if your client cannot send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

since.description: ISO timestamp: undo every change from then on.

writer.description: Only undo changes by this writer.

name: rollback_app_data
title: Undo changes to your charm's data
